title: Income-tax Act — Section 80U (Deduction in case of a person with disability)

content.overview: Section 80U allows a deduction from gross total income: Deduction in case of a person with disability.
content.glance: Section 80U allows a deduction from gross total income: Deduction in case of a person with disability.
content.study: Chapter VI-A deduction. Section 80U: Deduction in case of a person with disability. The deduction is allowed from gross total income subject to the conditions, limits and mode-of-payment rules in the section, and it cannot create a loss under the head.
